jtbd.jtbd_title: SAT Reading: evidence-first method & annotation system
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Adopt an ‘evidence ladder’ flow, constrain skimming, and use a tight annotation scheme to reduce vacillation errors.

facts.name: annotation_scheme
facts.value: Q#, line ref, claim arrow, elimination ticks

interactions.user_ask: I second-guess a lot on reading. How do I stop?
interactions.jenny_reply: No evidence, no change. If you switch answers, you must paste the quote that forced the switch.

interactions.user_ask: What’s the best way to annotate quickly?
interactions.jenny_reply: Use minimal marks: line refs + claim arrows + elimination ticks. No paragraphs of notes.

outcomes.name: reading_protocol_v1
outcomes.details: Evidence ladder + annotation scheme embedded into routine
